notes: SHIP v1.14.461 - BUILD'S CONTINUE CAN NO LONGER FAIL SILENTLY. THE REPORT: on a real iPhone the CONTINUE button on BUILD / FIELD MODE looked active and did nothing when tapped. Screen state was rack s1:002, Platform not in Master, Phase 1 of 5 MECHANICAL, 0%. THE HONEST FINDING FIRST, because it shapes what this ship claims: that exact state REPRODUCES CLEANLY in the harness and CONTINUE WORKS there. The button measures 326 by 56, hit-tests to itself, has pointer-events auto with nothing covering it, calls deploy_showRackDetail without throwing, and the host renders 390px of content with a working back control. So this ship does NOT claim to have fixed the owner's specific failure and must not be read as having done so. WHAT IT DOES FIX is the reason that failure was INVISIBLE, which is a defect in its own right and is provable here. THE PATH HAD THREE SILENT EXITS. First and worst, deploy_showRackDetail contained a bare if not c return - a silent return on the operational centre's primary action, and it bailed AFTER its side effects had already run: ops-detail added to body, nav_push, activeContext_setRack, stripeView_setRack and wakeLock_evaluate. So the application believed it had navigated to a rack detail it never drew, and the CTA's own try/catch could not help because nothing threw. Second, deploy_ensureDeployPanelVisible gave up silently when the deploy sub-tab button was absent, leaving the host switched off for a caller that was about to render into it. Third, there was no check that the render landed anywhere visible - an innerHTML into a hidden or zero-height host succeeds perfectly, which is this repo's recorded silent-success-into-a-hidden-node class and reads to a technician as a control that does nothing. THE FIXES ARE SURGICAL. No redesign, no CSS changes, no refactoring of unrelated code. The missing-host return now warns with the reason, toasts that the Build surface is not mounted, and CLEARS ops-detail so the app does not keep believing it navigated. The missing sub-tab button now warns. And after innerHTML a deferred rAF measures the host: if it is zero-height or display none or visibility hidden, it warns with the measured values and toasts that the rack workflow drew off-screen. The rAF defer matters - measuring synchronously at innerHTML would report a false zero on a host that is about to lay out correctly. A DIAGNOSTIC ARTIFACT WORTH RECORDING, because it nearly produced a fix for nothing. The first diagnostic seeded storage and then reloaded AFTER boot, which re-showed the boot splash and left pe-tapcatch - its full-screen inset zero tap catcher - over the page. elementFromPoint duly reported the splash intercepting CONTINUE, which looks exactly like the reported symptom. Seeding through the fixture instead made it vanish. Prove an environment artifact is not the cause before fixing what it appears to show. RUNS: spec 41 - 3 passed on phone-webkit. GATES: three-stamp lockstep at .461, inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, brace balance, 0 bare LF, 0 mojibake. DEVICE-VERIFY: tap CONTINUE on BUILD. PASS is entering the rack workflow for the active rack. If it still does nothing, the useful outcome is now the MESSAGE - Build surface is not mounted, or drew off-screen, or still complete silence - and which one appears says where to look next.
